title: Schedule-only edits did not request a new key/value backup
reproduction: Change named sets, global schedule and URL schedules; inspect pending Android backup requests separately from an explicit backup.
expected: Actual configuration changes notify Android; unchanged configuration, cancel and last-run bookkeeping do not.
observed: Baseline: 0 of 10 edits queued. An unchanged URL edit also discarded its last-run timestamp.
fix: Notify after effective configuration changes; share URL schedule mutation code and leave last-run intact on no-op.
test_evidence: API 34: all 10 edits queued, 5 negative controls stayed unqueued; all 15 queue/timestamp checks passed. See deep-signoff/nov26-backup-queue-results.csv. No cloud timing claim.
